# support model sweep
"does any candidate answer better than the control, at what cost?"

control vs 3 candidates · tpl-support

**Pass rate: the evidence cannot tell candidate-a and control apart. Of 828 trials, control passed 167. Of 753, candidate-a passed 173. The interval allows candidate-a to be as much as 3 points worse or 8 better. Pass rate: candidate-b against control shown worse. Of 828 trials, control passed 167. Of 757, candidate-b passed 100. The interval puts candidate-b between 2 and 13 points worse. Pass rate: the evidence cannot tell candidate-c and control apart. Of 828 trials, control passed 167. Of 753, candidate-c passed 187. The interval allows candidate-c to be as much as 1 points worse or 10 better.**

Request settings on tpl-support were not confirmed as sent, so the judge or the simulated user there may have run on other settings than asked.

Judged scores on tpl-support are directional until people's labels calibrate the judge.

## Scorecard

**By aspect**

| Aspect | Cases | ▸ con
